# Resume Integration Requirements Checklist: Update From Resume

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, precision, consistency, and coverage of requirements for integrating authentic resume data and downloadable assets into the profile site.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Scope

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required candidate profile fields (name, headline, bio, location, phone, email, LinkedIn) explicitly specified for the Home/About page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are career milestone attributes (company name, role title, date range, achievement bullets) specified for each historical role in the Experience page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are project showcase card elements (title, tagline, architectural description, technology badges, demo/repo links) fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are technical skill domains and categorization groups (Generative AI, Vector DBs, Full-Stack, Cloud & Infra, Certifications) exhaustively defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are all verified communication channels and social links specified without placeholder or mock URLs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is the standardized relative URL path and filename for the public downloadable resume file unambiguously defined across all pages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the primary CTA button labels and placement locations on the Home hero and Contact pages clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the relationship between the uploaded source resume (`resources/RaghuAIEng.pdf`) and the standardized asset (`resources/resume.pdf`) precisely documented? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK009 Do contact channel definitions (email, phone, LinkedIn, location) align consistently across `index.html`, `contact.html`, and `site-footer`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Are technical terminology and role designations consistent between the Experience, Projects, and Skills specifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification adhere to the zero-build static architecture and zero-automated-testing mandates defined in the project constitution? [Consistency, Constitution Principles II & IV]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are fallback behaviors specified if a visitor attempts to access the resume download before `resources/resume.pdf` is generated? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are browser viewing vs. downloading behaviors (e.g. `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`) specified for cross-platform PDF handling? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements documented for updating the resume file in the future without modifying HTML source links? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 Can the requirement that 100% of generic placeholder text is replaced with authentic data be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the 1-click resume access criterion from Home and Contact pages be definitively validated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Are zero-broken-link criteria testable across all external contact and social profile anchors? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK017) for easy reference
